## What's new in 0.2.0
- **In-app updates.** Icuity now checks for new versions and offers to install them. Use **Icuity ▸ Check for Updates…** any time, or turn on automatic installation in **Settings ▸ Updates**. An update waits until unsaved edits are saved. - **Your own zones.** Workout previews and targets use your intervals.icu settings for each sport: FTP, threshold heart rate, threshold pace and zones. - **Fixes.** Long calendar events keep their full length, the sidebar comes back when you widen the window, server errors are shown in plain language, and Undo Delete no longer lingers after you switch accounts.
This is the last version you need to install by hand. Later versions arrive through the app.
